If a nonzero original physical pivot has rank-two Schur-complement cross product Delta_S, then ||p_Q||infinity <=4sqrt(6)|d|^-1/2 Delta_S^-1/4.
Q=(X1+Y1)^2-(X2+Y2)^2+Z^2 has spectrum {2,-2,1,0,0} and ||p_Q||infinity <=4sqrt(6) for all permitted laws.

The account01/B19 target family A_m with spectrum {1,1,-1} has no nonzero scalar pivot whose Schur complement has any rank-two disjoint cross block; every possible pivot leaves only a rank-one star. The same family is nevertheless uniformly bounded after high-cardinality hyperbolic-square aggregation.
